best_direction.angle_title: After the injury: finding a different way to contribute
best_direction.core_claim: This is not an injury story. It is about how the student found a different way to matter to the team once performance was no longer available.
best_direction.why_this_is_the_real_story: The physical return is not the interesting part. The essay is the period before it — when the student had to figure out how to contribute without tying it to their own performance.
best_direction.what_it_reveals_about_the_student: It shows that the student can redefine what it means to participate in a team — moving from personal performance to something less focused on themselves.
best_direction.why_it_beats_the_obvious_angle: A perseverance essay centers on the comeback. This one centers on what changed in the student's understanding of participation before the comeback — a less common and more revealing version of the story.
best_direction.main_risk_if_written_poorly: If written as an inspirational arc, it will feel generic and the reader will not learn anything specific about how this student thinks.
best_direction.next_move: Write the moment when your previous way of contributing was no longer available. Then write one scene after that — where you were participating in a different way. The underlying subject is the shift from personal setback to renewed contribution.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: Execution quality and accomplishment evidence in the same experience.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It can show capability, but it underweights internal change and essay-level tension.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can collapse into an activity summary without a deeper interpretive claim.

alternatives.what_this_angle_would_focus_on: How your actions affected other people and community outcomes.
alternatives.why_it_is_weaker: It carries moral seriousness, but the self-revision arc is less sharply evidenced than the winner.
alternatives.failure_mode: Can become broad values prose if the turning moment is not dramatized.

depth_signals.detected_tension: The tension is between what happened and what it actually changed in you.
depth_signals.obvious_but_weaker_angle: Obvious but weaker angle: motivation and grit as abstract traits.
depth_signals.essay_opportunity: Frame the essay around the shift from personal setback to renewed contribution.
